description: PRD-43: Platform Security Hardening & Architecture Remediation — Fix 3 critical, 7 high, 7 medium, 5 low severity vulnerabilities and 12 architectural issues. OWASP API Security Top 10 compliance, auth on all endpoints, SQL injection elimination, runtime crash fixes, rate limiting, security headers, and architecture decomposition.

userStories.title: Flip REQUIRE_AUTH default to secure-by-default
userStories.description: As a platform operator, I want authentication required by default so that deployments are secure without manual configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: In orchestrator/core/auth/hybrid.py, change REQUIRE_AUTH default from empty string (falsy) to True
Anonymous fallback only activates when REQUIRE_AUTH is explicitly set to false/0/off
The hardcoded fallback UUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 is removed or only used in explicit dev mode
Add REQUIRE_AUTH=false to orchestrator/.env for local development
Typecheck passes
